title: Battalion multi-user hierarchy, separate master template, and Central Auth SSO integration
content:
Battalion completes its transition to a multi-user RPG architecture with strict account tier isolation, an independent Master Startup Template system, and first-class integration with JeffersonWM Central Auth.

What changed:

  • 4-Tier Account Hierarchy: Structured system roles into Owner (wm, owner with system-wide switcher and audit oversight), Admin (app-scoped administration), Authenticated Users (private isolated task/habit/mood logs), and Public/Guests (read-only dashboards via share links). Owner's personal gameplay history (Level 9, 444 completed tasks, 36,795 gold) remains strictly isolated in Account ID 1.
  • Dedicated Master Startup Template: Created an independent template account (master_template, Account ID 2, slug template) pre-seeded with 18 starter quests and 8 starter habits. New users signing in are automatically provisioned with a fresh clone of this starter kit under their own unique user_id.
  • Template Manager & Persistent JSON Changelog: Added a dedicated Master Template tab in Settings for Owner to adjust starting HP, Energy, Stress, Gold, starter tasks, and starter habits. Every modification records versioned diffs into template_changelog, requires an author change summary, and notifies the Central Auth audit stream. Dedicated buttons allow downloading the template and complete changelog as JSON.
  • Central Auth SSO & Live Status: Connected Battalion to https://auth.jeffersonwm.com with automated session detection on landing/login, a direct “🔑 Sign In with Central Auth” SSO button, and live status badges (🟢 Central Auth / 🔐 Local) in the status bar and public dashboard.
  • Top-Bar Switcher & Public Share Links: Relocated the Owner account switch dropdown to the sticky top status bar immediately to the left of the stat meters. Added a 1-click Public Share Link card with custom slug editing in Settings.
